A Hidden Gem in Hanoi: Exceptional Service and the Best Shisha!
Oct 2025 • Friends
This venue is the perfect spot if you’re looking for a relaxing, slow-paced evening in Hanoi. Everything about our visit screamed quality, from the laid-back atmosphere to the incredible service.

The staff treated us absolutely amazingly. They were attentive, friendly, and genuinely went out of their way to make sure we felt welcomed and taken care of throughout our entire visit. It’s this kind of world-class hospitality that really elevates an evening from good to exceptional.

But the real showstopper? The shisha. They likely serve the best shisha I have ever smoked. The flavor was incredibly smooth, clean, and perfectly mixed—a true testament to their quality standards. If you are a shisha enthusiast, this alone is worth the trip.

As an added bonus, the value here is fantastic. And here's a great tip: if you purchase a round of regular shots, they generously follow up with complimentary house shots as a thank you! It’s a fun, unexpected perk that just adds to the overall enjoyment.

Overall, it was an absolute pleasure spending time here. Whether you’re stopping by for a perfectly crafted cocktail, premium shisha, or just a friendly face, you’re guaranteed a wonderful time. Highly, highly recommended!

Awesome place to chill
Apr 2025 • Friends
The Slow Cocktail and Shisha Lounge is an absolute gem. The vibe is chill and inviting, perfect for a relaxed evening with friends. Their Piña Colada is hands down one of the best I’ve ever had — creamy, refreshing, and bursting with tropical flavor. We also tried their Sex on the Beach, which was equally impressive, well-balanced and delicious. The cocktails are clearly made with care and quality ingredients. The shisha options are great too, with smooth flavors and good variety. Overall, a fantastic spot to unwind, enjoy great drinks, and soak in a laid-back, stylish atmosphere. Highly recommended!
